newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Deadline ends for Estonian Shipping bids.
newsitem.headline: Deadline ends for Estonian Shipping bids.

text.p: The bid deadline for 70 percent of the state-owned Estonian Shipping Co ended on Thursday and the privatisation agency said it was pleased with the response.
"We had a really good response, showing that the company has attracted a lot of attention," a spokesman for the Estonian Privatisation Agency (EPA) told Reuters.
He would not reveal how many bids were entered or name any of the potential buyers.
The shipping company is one of Estonia's most successful state-owned firms. It has a share capital of 107.9 million kroons and its first-half turnover was 587 million kroons.
It employs 2,385 people and has 47 vessels and operates a profitable ferry service between Tallinn and Helsinki.
Investors rumoured to interested in the shipping company are A.P. Moeller's Maersk and the investment arms of local banks, including Hansa Investments, part of leading bank, Hansapank.
Maersk recently won the right to privatise the national airline, Estonian Air.
